5. Heat released = m × s × $\Delta$t
$= 10 \times 4.2 \times (50 - 30)$
$= 10 \times 4.2 \times 20$
$= 840 \text{ J}$
Hence, the correct option is (a).

6. Water can dissolve many inorganic salts in it
because it has high dielectric constant.
Hence, the correct option is (c).

7. $\mathrm{SO}_2$ is an acidic oxide since it forms $\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{SO}_3$ on
reaction with water.
Hence, the correct option is (d).

8. $2\mathrm{Na} + 2\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \rightarrow 2\mathrm{NaOH} + \mathrm{H}_2$
1 molecule Na liberates 0.5 molecules of $\mathrm{H}_2$.
$\mathrm{Ca} + 2\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \rightarrow \mathrm{Ca}(\mathrm{OH})_2 + \mathrm{H}_2$
1 molecule of Ca liberates 1 molecule of $\mathrm{H}_2$.
$3\mathrm{Fe} + 4\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \rightarrow \mathrm{Fe}_3\mathrm{O}_4 + 4\mathrm{H}_2$

1 molecule of Fe liberates $\frac{4}{3} = 1.33$ molecule of
$\mathrm{H}_2$.
$2\mathrm{Al} + 3\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \rightarrow \mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{O}_3 + 3\mathrm{H}_2$

1 molecule of Al gives rise to $\frac{3}{2} = 1.5$ molecule
of $\mathrm{H}_2$
$\therefore$ The order is ABDC.
Hence, the correct option is (a).

9. The order is DABC.
Hence, the correct option is (c).

10. 25 g of the salt is present in $225 - 25 = 200$ g of
the solvent.

$\therefore \text{Solubility} = \frac{25}{200} \times 100 = 12.5$

4. Let $x$ calories is the amount of heat supplied.

$$ \frac{\text{Mass of ice}}{\text{Mass of water}} = \frac{\frac{x}{80}}{\frac{x}{540}} $$

$$ = \frac{540}{80} = 27:4 $$

Hence, the correct option is (b).
